title: Motion 100 sample pack
note: Symlinks into gitignored clone; run from Mac after clone.

items.oneLiner: Parts of an object move in the same direction with slightly offset start and stop times.
A brief movement in the opposite direction prepares the viewer for the main action.
Easing changes velocity over the course of an animation while keeping its distance and duration constant.
An object briefly exceeds its target scale before returning and settling.
An object stretches as it gains speed and squashes on impact while keeping the product of its axis scales constant.
Multiple elements appear in sequence with a consistent delay between them.
An object follows a curved trajectory instead of a straight line.
An attached extremity continues moving through inertia after the main body stops, then settles later.
items.ease: none 몸통 / power2.out 관성 / power1.inOut 감쇠

items.oneLiner: Differences in scale and entrance timing establish a reading order that prioritizes important information.
Staggered strips open to assemble a complete image.
Blurred text or imagery resolves into sharp focus.
An element fades in while sliding into position.
An edge-on element rotates around a 3D axis to face the viewer.
An element grows from a small scale to its final size.
A short scale beat where an element grows slightly and returns to its size in place.
A circle or rectangle is drawn around a target and then erased.
Among items already laid out, one lights up at a time and the highlight hands off to the next.
An element oscillates on both sides of its rest position or angle, then stops.
Characters rise from below and fade in with a staggered delay.
A highlighter band sweeps from left to right behind a key phrase.
Words hit the center at a large scale on regular beats and quickly settle.
A title rises into clipped windows to reveal one line at a time.
Symbols cycle in each character position before resolving into the final text from left to right.
A sentence appears one character at a time at regular intervals while a cursor follows the insertion point.
An SVG path draws beneath a key phrase from left to right in a single stroke.
A phrase changes color and scale within a stationary sentence while surrounding text fades.
Three lines of 200px+ serif type sweep across the frame in opposite directions at different speeds, then one key word slams to a stop dead center.
Scene A fades out as scene B fades in at the same time.
An incoming scene pushes the existing scene out by the same amount in the same direction.
A moving boundary progressively reveals the new scene behind it.
A circular mask expands from a point to reveal the next scene.
Matching shapes at the same position and size connect two scenes across a cut.
The same element changes shape and color to become a component of the next scene.
A rapid horizontal sweep with horizontal blur and sharp deceleration settles into the next scene.
The opening in the letter O enlarges to carry the viewer through to the next scene inside it.
Two scenes overlap while blurred, swap, and the new scene sharpens back into focus.
A white flash covers the frame, the scene changes at the peak, and brightness recovers.
A page corner curls up, exposing the back and a soft shadow, and turns to the next screen.
The old element shrinks toward a pivot while the new one grows in to take its place.
Two halves of the frame slide apart or together in opposite directions and swap scenes.
Video bands split horizontally or vertically slide at slightly different timings to reveal the next screen.
A step-title card appears between scenes, holds briefly, then hands off to the next scene.
Video blocks momentarily misalign and color channels or ghosts break apart while the scene is replaced.
Rectangular tiles cut from the scene flip in sequence to reveal the next scene on their backs.
A vermilion circle hard-cuts to a serif letter O at the same position and size, then the O morphs into a 62% donut chart.
Pixels whose noise value falls below the progress disappear first, so blotchy holes spread through the first scene and reveal the next.
A soft, bent diagonal edge sweeps across the frame while both plates near the edge stretch and smear along the direction of travel.
Mid-zoom on the center, a straight edge moves across the frame and reveals the new scene.
A camera move that slowly zooms into a still image while panning diagonally.
A camera move that scans a wide scene in one direction while keeping the scale constant.
A motion effect that creates depth by moving nearer layers faster and distant layers more slowly as the camera moves.
A camera move that slowly approaches a fixed focal point in a sentence or scene.
A focus shift that swaps sharpness between foreground and background subjects without changing their positions.
A motion that centers and enlarges a specific coordinate in an overview diagram to reveal detail.
A frame-filling 939 acts as a window onto an editorial world, and the camera dives into a stroke until the whole world is revealed.
A continuous 5,400px camera pan across six editorial plates settles on a scarlet focus.
Dive into a scarlet dot three times as nested plates expand through a continuous 2,744× zoom.
An editorial page tilts back by 55 degrees to reveal its grid before returning to one frontal figure.
In one pinned scene, a single scroll progress value p drives a title mask reveal, an assembling diagram, and a parallaxing background number together.
An animation that draws a leader line from a point on a chart and then reveals an annotation.
An animation in which bars grow from a baseline to lengths proportional to their values.
An animation in which a number increases from 0 to its target value while decelerating.
An animation that moves scattered dots into orderly groups by category.
An animation that progressively reveals a path from start to finish.
An animation that fills a specified number of cells in sequence within a grid representing the whole.
Bar lengths and vertical ranks interpolate between time steps.
Shares update by interpolating the start and end angles of each pie or donut slice.
A circular stroke fills to a target ratio with a synchronized label.
Vertices move along fixed radial axes to form or update a radar profile.
Flow ribbons grow from source toward destination, revealing the network stage by stage.
Stacked segments spread sideways, then move onto a shared baseline.
Highlighted table values become marks that move into a chart layout.
Change bars appear from the preceding cumulative endpoint until a total bar is reached.
An animation that reveals an answer in sequential token groups and gradually increases the opacity of each new group.
An animation in which a cursor follows a curved path to a target button and signals a click with a pressed state and ripple.
An animation that dims the surrounding screen while keeping one region fully opaque and framing it with brackets.
An animation in which a question is typed character by character at irregular intervals with a blinking caret at the end.
An animation that smoothly moves a long document upward, stops at a target paragraph, and marks it with a vertical line.
An animation that enlarges a small UI value in an adjacent circular callout and connects both locations with a line.
A panel expands from a fixed edge while adjacent content moves aside.
Messages appear in sequence while the previous conversation shifts upward.
Lift a translucent copy, carry it with the cursor, and settle it in a new slot.
Elements retain their identity as a layout changes position and size.
A dialog rises into focus as the backdrop dims.
An animation that connects one token to the tokens it references using arcs of varying thickness and opacity.
An animation that inserts new tokens into a fixed-length window and pushes out the oldest tokens first.
An animation that moves words to semantic coordinates so words with similar meanings cluster together.
An animation in which candidate probability bars grow, then the highest-probability candidate moves into a blank in the sentence.
A sequential reveal that leaves earlier stages dimmed as each new stage becomes active.
An animation that overlays before and after states of the same subject and compares them with a moving vertical divider.
An animation that separates a continuous sentence into spaced token fragments.
Reveal eight service nodes before their connecting edges.
Message arrows draw between actors in chronological order, highlighting each receiver.
The source remains visible as transformed code appears with linked corresponding tokens.
A signal moves to the next node, which becomes the active state.
Component vectors extend in sequence, then join tip to tail to form a resultant.
Loose shapes move and rotate until they lock into a single logo or a gap-free arrangement.
The outline or wireframe appears first, then the interior surfaces and color fill in.
Only a short bright stretch travels along the full line.
One shape splits into several smaller shapes, or several shapes merge into one.
